name: uberasm-graphical-air-meter-v2-0
title: Graphical Air Meter v2.0.2
description:
This is basically similar to the sprite version, but recoded from scratch, and more customizability. The amount of time the player can be in the water, unlike the sprite version, can be any value rather than restricted to powers of 2 "ticks" (which happens at every !CountDownFrequency+1 frames) starting at 255 units.

changelog
Code
2025-06-14 (v2.0.2) - small update
 - Removed some redundant code relating to storing EXB1 (Index
   0; the maximum air value) into scratch RAM.
 - Added a new feature: InvertFill extra byte. When nonzero,
   the displayed meter fills up from empty as the player loses
   air rather than decreases from full.

 - Clarify CTRL+F "Static end tiles option" inside
   AirMeterDefines.asm on that file rather than being vague.

2025-04-11 (v2.0.1) - description update

2025-04-06 (v2.0.1) - minor fixes and small features
 - Fixed a problem with the COURSE CLEAR! message when using
   stripe.
 - Added static end tiles support, for status bar, stripe, and
   sprite. This took me FOREVER making sure this works right.
2025-03-31 (v2.0) - BIG massive update
 - Uses updated version of the graphical bar system.
 - Vertical bar support.
 - Makes use of UAT v2.1's new features: extra bytes. This
   allows variations of the same level ASM without duplicates.
 --Included per-level different lengths of time of being in
   the water, what effect when the meter runs out (such as
   damage and refill), how fast the meter refills, how it
   drains.
 - Makes use of UAT's routines folder, really love that I can
   finally call another routine file from a routine file.
 -Supports stripe image and sprite OAM (does not occupy
  one of normal/pixi sprite's 12 or 22 slot).
 -When set to use sprite OAM, supports multiple tilesets for
  the bar rather than having a single set so you can have a
  per-level sprite graphics without conflicts (assuming you
  have enough tiles) with other GFX.
